aboutGame.title: What is Firefighting Sim?
paragraphs: Firefighting Sim is an authentic tactical emergency simulation that drops players into the boots of a frontline firefighter. Operating individually or as part of a four-player squad, you respond to alarms across sprawling urban maps, connect municipal hydrants, breach locked buildings, and rescue trapped civilians from dynamic structural infernos.

Powered by physics-driven fire propagation, convective heat transfer, and realistic smoke dynamics, every call requires tactical discipline. Our comprehensive wiki delivers verified vehicle breakdowns, keybind configurations, equipment stats, and step-by-step incident walkthroughs for both rookie responders and seasoned incident commanders.

modules.name: Firefighting Sim Beginner Guide
modules.description: This module introduces new players to the basic gameplay loop, firefighting procedures, equipment usage, mission preparation, and survival tips. It helps beginners understand how to respond to emergencies and complete missions efficiently.

highlights.detail: Conduct a 360-degree size-up around the structure to locate fire seats and smoke conditions.
Connect supply lines from a municipal hydrant to your engine before charging interior attacks.
Force exterior doors with a Halligan bar while controlling ventilation drafts to prevent flashovers.
Sweep thermal gas layers overhead and direct solid streams at fuel bases to knock down flames.

modules.name: Firefighting Sim Missions Guide
modules.description: A mission-focused section covering different emergency scenarios, objectives, locations, and recommended strategies. Players can learn how to handle fires, rescues, and special situations more effectively.

highlights.label: Rescues

highlights.label: Industrial
highlights.detail: Contain hazardous chemical storage drums and isolate high-voltage breaker panels.

highlights.label: Flashovers

modules.name: Firefighting Sim Multiplayer Guide
modules.description: This section covers cooperative gameplay, team roles, communication strategies, and multiplayer mission tips. It targets players searching for co-op features and team-based strategies.

highlights.detail: Designate dedicated squad roles: Pump Operator, Lead Nozzle, Forcible Entry, and Search & Rescue.
Establish hydrant supply connections immediately while the search team forces entry.
Maintain radio callouts when breaching interior doors to coordinate water sweeps against backdrafts.
Conduct coordinated room-by-room overhauls to confirm zero trapped occupants remain inside.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Firefighting Sim.

items.question: What is Firefighting Sim?
items.answer: Firefighting Sim is a realistic emergency rescue simulation where players suit up as firefighters to tackle dynamic building fires, operate authentic fire trucks, utilize specialized gear, and rescue civilians across solo and cooperative squad missions.

items.question: Does Firefighting Sim support cooperative multiplayer?
items.answer: Yes, Firefighting Sim features up to four-player cooperative multiplayer, enabling squad members to coordinate specialized roles like pump operation, nozzle attack, search and rescue, and rooftop ventilation.

items.question: What tools are most important for beginners in Firefighting Sim?
items.answer: Every rookie responder should master the Halligan bar for forcible door entry, the attack hose for knockdown suppression, and the Thermal Imaging Camera (TIC) for detecting hidden hotspots inside smoke-filled structures.

items.question: Can I play Firefighting Sim on PC and consoles?
items.answer: Yes, Firefighting Sim is available on PC via Steam as well as PlayStation and Xbox console platforms, offering complete keyboard/mouse and gamepad controller support.

items.question: How do you prevent flashovers and backdrafts in Firefighting Sim?
items.answer: Keep structural doors controlled before water is charged, sweep superheated gas layers at ceiling levels with water streams, and avoid breaking ventilation windows without an active attack line ready.
